checks.name: Environmental capital expenditure as a candidate subset of total capital expenditure

candidate_comparison.interpretation: The comparison is meaningful only if the ESG amount is verified to be included in the financial total.

activation_requirements: A non-synthetic financial disclosure is supplied by Extract and passes the financial contract.
Company, reporting period and reporting scope are verified as aligned.
Currency, scale and unit conversion are verified.
The accounting classification confirms that the ESG amount is a subset of the selected financial line.

result_policy.contradiction_policy: A missing financial line or unmatched candidate never creates Contradicted.
